summary: Executed backend pytest suite and frontend Playwright integration checks against public URL. Core toolkit flows load and route correctly; one functional issue found in VAT copy flow due clipboard permission error.

ui_bugs.issue: Copy result action throws Clipboard write permission error in runtime context; button text does not switch to 'Copied' and copy workflow fails when clipboard permission is denied.

integration_issues.issue: navigator.clipboard.writeText rejection is unhandled in copyResult, causing runtime page error.

action_items: Wrap navigator.clipboard.writeText in try/catch and add fallback UX/error message for denied clipboard permission.
Optionally assert copied state after successful clipboard write and keep behavior graceful when permission is blocked.
critical_code_review_comments: PremiumCapture uses generic error message for all backend failures; consider surfacing API validation message for better diagnostics.
Clipboard API path in VatCalculator lacks error handling and can throw uncaught runtime error.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ status records and unique waitlist emails during API tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoints /api/, /api/status, /api/waitlist all passed via external URL. Frontend flows for home/nav, invoice, quote, tax, receipts, templates, premium capture, and mobile routing were validated. Reproduce VAT copy issue by clicking copy button and checking console for Clipboard write permission denied error.
rca of the issue: RCA: In frontend/src/pages/VatCalculator.jsx copyResult awaits navigator.clipboard.writeText(text) without try/catch. When browser denies clipboard permission, promise rejects and function exits before setCopied(true), producing runtime error and no success feedback. Repro: open /vat-calculator -> click Copy result in restricted clipboard context -> observe console error and unchanged button state. Mitigation: catch rejection, show fallback message, and optionally use document.execCommand('copy') fallback for broader compatibility.
